verdict.rationale: HumanLayer offers a hosted cloud surface: tasks are controlled from app.humanlayer.com, and automation sessions are 'Cloud-visible'. But agent execution still runs on hosts you provide, such as a cloud VM, workstation, or remote workers running the daemon, and the docs emphasize bringing your own compute. So you avoid running the coordination backend, but not the agent runtime infrastructure. Missing for 10: vendor-managed compute or sandboxes that run agents with no self-provisioned host, documentation of a fully hosted execution tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a managed cloud offering to run agents without operating my own backend infrastructure

citations.quote: You will control the task from app.humanlayer.com on a machine or phone.
Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment
The host can be a cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine.
Bring your own compute, development environment, and agent harness, or run the HumanLayer stack on your workstation or remote workers.
